text:
**The evidence does not establish whether the 2023 tree removal was authorized.** It supports approximately 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss on the property, but does not establish its cause, legality or who carried it out.

The 2021 forest map classified 0.4 ha of the affected area as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 ha as outside mapped forest. Authorization would need to be checked against relevant permits and regulatory records.
